user.title: Set up your garden
user.description: Pick your region and soil so jobs and advice follow your climate. Add plants afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.soil: Most of your garden beds. Plants in pots use potting mix, and each plant can override this.
data_description.weather: Its forecast drives frost and heat alerts and the automations.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Used instead of the weather entity for heat misting.
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional. Rain in mm since 9 am. Enough rain counts as watering for garden beds.

menu_options.automations: Frost watering, heat misting and valves

automations.title: Frost watering, heat misting and valves
automations.description: Turn each automation on with its switch. These settings decide how it runs.

data.one_at_a_time: Run valves one at a time
data.auto_ack_minutes: Valve run that counts as watering

data_description.frost_threshold: Frost watering runs when tonight's forecast low is at or below this.
data_description.frost_time: Water the soil in the day before a frost night, so it holds warmth overnight.
data_description.frost_minutes: How long each water valve runs before a frost.
data_description.heat_threshold: Misting runs while the temperature is at or above this.
data_description.humidity_max: Misting adds little when the air is already humid.
data_description.rain_skip_mm: Rain forecast or measured above this lets watering wait.
data_description.max_run_minutes: A safety cap for every run, manual or automatic.
data_description.one_at_a_time: Keeps water pressure up when several valves share one tap.
data_description.auto_ack_minutes: A water valve running at least this long marks its plants as watered.

data_description.stage: Jobs and advice follow the stage. Change it later from the plant's stage select.
data_description.soil: Leave empty to use the garden's soil type.
data_description.moisture_sensor: Optional. A sensor near this plant. Several plants can share one.
data_description.water_valve: Optional. A valve or switch that waters this plant.
data_description.mist_valve: Optional. A valve or switch for misters near this plant.
data_description.dry_threshold: Soil moisture that counts as dry. Leave empty for the plant's usual level.

data_description.soil: Leave empty to use the garden's soil type.
data_description.dry_threshold: Soil moisture that counts as dry. Leave empty for the plant's usual level.
